Class LeadServiceTest

@IsTest
private class LeadServiceTest

Test class for LeadService. Validates Lead archival functionality including copying Lead records to LeadArchive__c, deleting original Leads, and proper error handling.

Methods

@IsTest
private static void archiveEmptySetTest()

Tests archival with an empty set of Lead IDs. Validates that the method handles empty input gracefully without errors and returns null.

@IsTest
private static void archiveFieldMappingTest()

Tests that Lead field values are correctly mapped to LeadArchive__c fields. Validates comprehensive field mapping including standard fields, custom fields, and address components.

@IsTest
private static void archiveLeadErrorTest()

Tests error handling when Lead archival fails due to invalid data. Validates that when archive() is called with a Lead containing invalid field values (e.g., invalid country code), the save fails, the original Lead is not deleted, and an ErrorLog__c record is created.

@IsTest
private static void archiveMultipleLeadsTest()

Tests successful archival of multiple Lead records. Validates bulk operation capability by archiving several Leads at once and verifying all are properly copied and deleted.

@IsTest
private static void archiveNonExistentLeadTest()

Tests archival with non-existent Lead IDs. Validates that the method handles invalid IDs gracefully by returning null results without throwing exceptions.

@IsTest
private static void archiveNullSetTest()

Tests archival with an empty set of Lead IDs. Validates that the method handles empty input gracefully without errors and returns null.

@IsTest
private static void archiveSingleLeadTest()

Tests successful archival of a single Lead record. Validates that when archive() is called with a valid Lead ID, a LeadArchive__c record is created with the copied field values and the original Lead is deleted.
